entries.question: Lari department appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for the Lari Cardiology department at KGMU, you must use the official online registration process, as walk-in appointments are not available.

### Booking Methods:
1.  **Online (Recommended):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "King George's Medical University" as the hospital. Follow the steps to select the Cardiology department, date, and time, and pay the ₹50 registration fee to download your slip.
2.  **ABHA/Health Care App:** You can register using your mobile number and OTP through the ABHA or Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission portal, following the same hospital selection flow.
3.  **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in:** If you arrive in person, you must bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP. You will receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

### Important Information:
*   **Referral:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, you must bring a valid referral letter for the Cardiology department.
*   **Timings:** The OPD ticket counter closes strictly at **1:00 PM**.
*   **Emergency:** If it is a cardiac emergency, please go directly to the Trauma Centre (Gate 14) for stabilization; patients are then transferred to the LARI Cardiology department as needed.
*   **Lari PRO Office:** For specific inquiries regarding Lari Cardiology, you may contact the PRO office at **9415099528**.

**Note:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (such as your full name, phone number, or health records) in this chat for your safety.

1.  **OPD mein dikhayein:** Sabse pehle Cardiology OPD mein jaakar doctor ko dikhayein. Doctor hi sahi procedure aur uske anumanit kharch (estimate) ke bare mein bata payenge.

Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical treatment ya kharch ki sahi jankari ke liye doctor ka paramarsh hi sarvopari hai. Kripya OPD slip katwayein aur doctor se milkar poori jankari lein.

* सबसे पहले [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) वेबसाइट पर जाएं।

* 'New Appointment' पर क्लिक करें।
* अपना मोबाइल नंबर डालें और OTP से सत्यापित (Verify) करें।
* विभाग (Department) चुनें और उपलब्ध तारीख और समय का चयन करें।
* मरीज का विवरण भरें और ₹50 का भुगतान करें।
* भुगतान सफल होने के बाद अपनी अपॉइंटमेंट स्लिप डाउनलोड कर लें।

* आप ABHA या संबंधित सरकारी हेल्थ केयर ऐप डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।
* वहां अपना मोबाइल नंबर और OTP के जरिए रजिस्टर करें।
* ORS की तरह ही अस्पताल और विभाग का चयन करके प्रक्रिया पूरी करें।

**3. SMS के माध्यम से:**
* आप अपने मोबाइल से `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर SMS भेज सकते हैं।

**कुछ जरूरी बातें:**
* OPD का शुल्क ₹50 है, जो आपको ऑनलाइन भुगतान करना होगा।
* यदि आप शहर से बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो अपने साथ संबंधित विभाग का वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र जरूर रखें।
* अपॉइंटमेंट लेने के बाद अस्पताल आने पर अपनी स्लिप साथ लाएं। 

अधिक सहायता के लिए आप KGMU के हेल्प डेस्क नंबर **0522-2258880** या **0522-3539333** पर भी संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

4. **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne ilaaj ke liye sambhandhit vibhag (department) ka referral zarur lekar aayein.

*   Main kisi bhi medical case ka nirdharan nahi kar sakta, isliye kripya turant apne sambhandhit vibhag ke doctor se paramarsh lein.
*   Emergency ki sthiti mein, aap seedhe **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** ja sakte hain.

To secure admission in MBBS at KGMU, you need to meet both academic eligibility criteria and competitive exam performance requirements. Here is the breakdown:

### 1. 12th Board Eligibility (Bihar Board)
For NEET eligibility, the National Medical Commission (NMC) requires you to pass 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as core subjects.

*   **Minimum Percentage:** You must secure a minimum aggregate of **50% marks** in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (taken together) if you belong to the General/EWS category.
*   **Reserved Category (SC/ST/OBC):** The requirement is **40% marks** in aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.
*   **Note:** Even though these are the minimum requirements to appear for NEET, KGMU is a highly competitive institution. Aiming for a high percentage in your Bihar Board exams will help you build a strong foundation for the NEET syllabus.

### 2. NEET Rank Required for KGMU
KGMU is one of the most sought-after medical colleges in India. Admission is based on the **All India Rank (AIR)** through NEET-UG.

*   **Competition Level:** KGMU usually fills its seats very early in the counseling process. 
*   **Expected Rank:** To be safe for a General/Unreserved seat at KGMU, you generally need to secure an **All India Rank (AIR) within the top 2,000 to 3,000**.
*   **NEET Score:** In terms of marks, this usually translates to a score of **670–680+ out of 720** (this can vary slightly every year based on the difficulty of the paper and the number of candidates).

### Important Advice for Your Preparation:
1.  **Don't worry about the Board Name:** It does not matter whether you are from the Bihar Board or any other state board. NEET is a national-level exam, and the paper is based on the NCERT curriculum.
2.  **Focus on NCERT:** Since you are in 11th grade, master your NCERT Physics, Chemistry, and Biology books thoroughly. Most NEET questions are directly derived from these.
3.  **Counseling:** Remember that for KGMU, you will participate in the **UP NEET Counseling** (conducted by the Uttar Pradesh government). Since you are from Bihar, you will likely be applying under the **All India Quota (AIQ)** seats (15% of total seats) during the national counseling (MCC) or if you meet the domicile/residency requirements for the state-level counseling.

**My suggestion:** Since you have plenty of time (11th and 12th), focus on building your concepts. Do not stress about the "rank" right now; stress about "understanding the concepts." If your concepts are strong, the rank will follow.

*Disclaimer: Admission cut-offs change every year based on the difficulty of the exam and the performance of all students across India. Always check the official [KGMU Admissions](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) page for the latest updates.*
